title: Alexandr Wang on Meta's personal agents bet, trust as first principle, and building a talent-dense AI lab
summary: In this Economic Times interview, Wang explains why Meta sees 2026 as the year of the personal agent and how its three and a half billion daily users give it a distribution edge. He argues trust is the first principle for intimate AI products, and that talent density, compute and no artificial deadlines make the best research environment. He also says AI tools empower small businesses more than they disrupt jobs.

principles.text: Shift from passive, search-style AI to agents that work for you around the clock and act on your goals.
principles.quote: We're moving away from these AI systems that are passive and are sort of more search-based to ones where they're working for you 24/7. They understand your goals. They're able to take actions on your behalf.

principles.text: Distribution at scale is the edge: reach billions of daily users to make personal agents globally ubiquitous.
principles.quote: At Meta, we have three and a half billion people who use our platforms every single day. And we have an opportunity to really make personal agents globally ubiquitous in a way that we think that very few companies have the opportunity to.

principles.text: For intimate AI products, build trust first. It is the long-term North Star and first principle.
principles.quote: your personal agent that is truly personalised to you will be a technology that is more intimate than any technology has ever been historically.

principles.text: New technology creates new formats and products, so agentic commerce is an opportunity for businesses, not a threat.
principles.quote: consumer technology will continue evolving because new technology enables entirely new formats, entirely new technology, entirely new products for our users.

principles.text: Attract top talent with density, compute and scientific rigor, not artificial deadlines or compensation alone.
principles.quote: Smart people want to be surrounded by other very brilliant people who can help push them and they can learn from and create a very special environment that is frankly not possible in other circumstances.

principles.text: Empowering small businesses and creators with AI tools yields opportunity that outstrips disruption.
principles.quote: when we empower more and more small businesses, more creators with AI tools and AI products and AI platforms, the opportunity vastly outstrips any of the disruption.
